messages:
pagerbot: PAGER — P0: unusual auth traffic pattern hitting /v1/token from many distinct IPs; rate + token reuse detected. Auto-triage -> possible leaked debug logs. Paging alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: I'm on it. TL;DR: confirm blast radius, block suspicious IPs, check S3/CI for recent public uploads.

ben_sre: Checking ingress. I see a ~3x spike from ~120 unique IPs starting 14:07 UTC. Requests include repeated refresh_token rotation calls with identical tokens. Dumping X-Forwarded-For samples now.

carol_security: Likely symptom of leaked tokens. Any recent debug log uploads or CI artifacts with env vars? tagging @lisa_custsuccess for customer impact check.

lisa_custsuccess: I'm pulling customer sessions. Early look: 4 sessions flagged; 3 are internal staging apps, 1 is a low-traffic customer trial. Not seeing recent user complaints yet. Will notify PM & CS if customer token must be rotated.

dave_ops: I'm prepping a quick containment play: 1) WAF block list for the IP set; 2) rotate service keystore for auth-proxy; 3) revoke staging tokens. Suggest KMS rekey as a follow-up.

ben_sre: WAF rule pushed to block the top 50 IPs. Confirmed traffic drop ~70% for blocked set. Still seeing some hits from new IPs.

alice_oncall: Good. Carol, can you confirm if any S3 buckets had public ACL changes or recent CI artifact uploads with creds?

carol_security: S3 audit shows a bucket (redwood-staging-logs) with an object uploaded 13:58 UTC named `debug_dump_2026-03-20.log.gz`. ACL=private but lifecycle set to replicate -> external account (past infra config). Pulling object to inspect.

infra_bot: Audit-note: replication target account acct-889 has active cross-account replication role since 2024-11-02. Recent config change: replication exclude-filter removed 2026-03-18.

carol_security: Downloaded snippet: it contains `AUTH_TOKEN=` lines and occasional full bearer headers. This looks like root cause. Moving to containment steps: a) snapshot and quarantine object b) rotate all keys/tokens present in dump c) disable replication role until investigation.

dave_ops: For rotation: plan to rotate keystore on auth-proxy service. Quick CLI for reroll (run from secure bastion):
```
# rotate auth proxy keystore
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id arn:aws:secrets:auth-proxy/keystore --secret-string file://new-keystore.json
# rotate service keys and trigger deploy
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy
```

alice_oncall: Execute containment now. Ben, block replication role. Dave, start keystore rotation. Lisa, prepare customer comms template (only if token revocation affects them). Carol, evidence saved to secure-case-2998765432.

ben_sre: Replication role disabled. Confirmed no further replication events after 14:30 UTC.

dave_ops: Keystore update in progress. Rolling restart on auth-proxy shortly. Will publish runbook steps to runbook channel.

carol_security: Evidence saved and hashed (sha256: abc...def). Adding flags for potential data-leak privacy notification. Looping in legal_team.

legal_team: Acknowledged. Please capture scope: list of customers with affected tokens and time windows. We'll prepare notification decision matrix.

lisa_custsuccess: Customer list attached in secure ticket: 1 external trial (id 8742) with session created 2026-03-20T13:55Z. Recommending rotating that customer's API key and offering remediation help.

alice_oncall: Status update: WAF blocks in place, replication disabled, keystore rotation underway, affected customer flagged, legal engaged. Pagerbot escalation suppressed for now. Assigning next on-call ben_sre (handoff in 30m).

ben_sre: I'll take next watch. Leaving a quick check list: 1) verify all tokens from dump revoked 2) confirm no more leaked objects 3) run audit of CI logs last 7 days.

carol_security: Post-rotation check: no token acceptance events after 14:46 UTC for revoked tokens. Suggest full KMS key swap on auth-secrets within 24h and an org-wide artifact-replication policy change.

alice_oncall: Agreed. Action items recorded in ticket #INC-2998765432: containment done, mitigation in progress, follow-ups: KMS swap, replication policy fix, customer notify draft, postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: INCIDENT update logged -> INC-2998765432. Severity changed to P1 (contained). Next update window 16:00 UTC or sooner on new findings.
